title: feature request - Improve priming process of Dana pumps for blind people!
symptom: Blind users cannot see the pump display to perform priming and tube filling on Dana pumps, and if the autosetter is damaged it becomes difficult. The user requests the ability to insert priming data via AAPS instead of on the pump.
cause: Dana pump does not support this functionality; AAPS cannot do it directly and fakes it by doing a bolus.
fix: No fix provided; the maintainer states that Dana pump does not support this functionality and that AAPS cannot do it directly, only faked by doing a bolus.
evidence_quote: Dana pump doesn't support this functionality
